trailhead.label: Le Prese station on the Bernina railway, the board’s start

cautions: The west shore runs right beside the Bernina railway: lead short.
About 120 m on the main road near the lake: lead short for passing cars.
Lakeside paths are busy with families in summer: keep your dog close.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
